sourceTitle: Muse Is Now Available in Singapore: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
originalTitle: Muse Is Now Available in Singapore: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
author: ginamurphy

blocks.text: Following our global announcement of Muse, we are excited to share that Muse is now available in Singapore.
blocks.zh: 我们全球宣布穆斯之后,我们兴奋地分享,Muse现在可以在新加坡使用。
blocks.en: Following our global announcement of Muse, we are excited to share that Muse is now available in Singapore.

blocks.zh: https://about.fb.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Introduction-Muse_Sizzle-Video.mp4 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-09-22.

blocks.text: What Muse Can Do in Singapore
blocks.zh: 新加坡的缪斯能做什么
blocks.en: What Muse Can Do in Singapore

blocks.text: Connectors are a big reason Muse can do so much. People in Singapore can connect their Muse to apps they already use, including Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram, so it can help them manage email, coordinate schedules and draw on saved content to get everyday tasks done.
blocks.zh: 连接器是一个很大的原因 缪斯可以做这么多。新加坡人可以把Muse连接到他们已经使用的应用软件上,包括Gmail在内,谷歌日历和Instagram,这样可以帮助他们管理电子邮件,协调日程安排,并利用已保存的内容完成日常任务。
blocks.en: Connectors are a big reason Muse can do so much. People in Singapore can connect their Muse to apps they already use, including Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram, so it can help them manage email, coordinate schedules and draw on saved content to get everyday tasks done.

blocks.text: Early local connector partners in Singapore include Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines, Agoda, ShopBack, Klook, Trip.com and Lazada spanning shopping, groceries, dining and travel. Connector features will roll out progressively, with some experiences becoming available after launch.
blocks.zh: 新加坡当地早期的连接伙伴包括Shopee,抓起来新加坡航空公司阿戈达,店头,克丽丝Trip.com和拉扎达在购物杂货,吃饭和旅行。连接器的功能将逐渐推出,发射后将获得一些经验。
blocks.en: Early local connector partners in Singapore include Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines, Agoda, ShopBack, Klook, Trip.com and Lazada spanning shopping, groceries, dining and travel. Connector features will roll out progressively, with some experiences becoming available after launch.

blocks.text: You can ask Muse to research products and compare prices before buying on Shopee or Lazada, or plan grocery shopping and dining through GrabMart and Grab Dine Out. You can also explore travel, ticketing and reservation options through Singapore Airlines, Agoda, Klook and Trip.com, or earn cashback on travel and shopping plus claim in-store dining deals through ShopBack.
blocks.zh: 你可以要求Muse在购买Shopee或Lazada之前 研究产品和比较价格或者计划通过GrabMart和Grab Dine出去买杂货和吃饭.你也可以探险旅行,通过新加坡航空公司的售票和订票方案,阿戈达,Klook和Trip.com, 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02.或通过ShopBack的商店餐饮交易赚取现金。
blocks.en: You can ask Muse to research products and compare prices before buying on Shopee or Lazada, or plan grocery shopping and dining through GrabMart and Grab Dine Out. You can also explore travel, ticketing and reservation options through Singapore Airlines, Agoda, Klook and Trip.com, or earn cashback on travel and shopping plus claim in-store dining deals through ShopBack.

blocks.text: Making this technology work for everyone requires careful design and engineering to operate more safely. That’s where most of the effort on this project went and this post explains our approach in detail. Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated computer in the cloud that securely stores the data and credentials for the services you connect, while keeping passwords and payment methods out of the agent’s view. You choose what your Muse can access, and it checks with you before sensitive actions such as sending an email or making a purchase.
blocks.zh: 要使这种技术为每个人服务,需要仔细的设计和工程,以便更加安全地运作.本文详细解释了我们的做法。Muse运行在Muse Secure VM上,云中一台专用计算机,用于安全地存储您所连接的服务的数据和证书,密码和支付方法不覆盖代理商的视野。你选择你的缪斯可以访问的东西,在发送电子邮件或购买邮件等敏感行动之前,它会与您核对。
blocks.en: Making this technology work for everyone requires careful design and engineering to operate more safely. That’s where most of the effort on this project went and this post explains our approach in detail. Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated computer in the cloud that securely stores the data and credentials for the services you connect, while keeping passwords and payment methods out of the agent’s view. You choose what your Muse can access, and it checks with you before sensitive actions such as sending an email or making a purchase.

blocks.text: Nicole Tan, Managing Director, Meta Singapore said: “Muse is your personal agent, built to help make everyday life easier. We are connecting Muse with some of the most iconic brands in Singapore and the region, so you can get things done with the services you already use and love.”
blocks.zh: 妮可・谭总裁,Meta Singapore说:“穆斯是你的私人代理人,是用来帮助改善日常生活的我们正在将Muse与新加坡和该地区的一些最具标志性的品牌联系起来,这样你就可以用你已经使用和热爱的服务来完成事情。”
blocks.en: Nicole Tan, Managing Director, Meta Singapore said: “Muse is your personal agent, built to help make everyday life easier. We are connecting Muse with some of the most iconic brands in Singapore and the region, so you can get things done with the services you already use and love.”

blocks.text: Muse is available in Singapore on iOS, Android, and muse.ai, and coming soon to AI glasses. It’s free for most of what people need, with subscription plans for people who want to do more.
blocks.zh: Muse在新加坡可以访问iOS,Android(机器人),(机器人),(机器人)和缪赛,并且很快来到AI眼镜。大部分人需要的都是免费的给想做更多工作的人订了订书计划
blocks.en: Muse is available in Singapore on iOS, Android, and muse.ai, and coming soon to AI glasses. It’s free for most of what people need, with subscription plans for people who want to do more.
